headline: No Dogs in Space is a music history podcast for true obsessives
summary: Music history podcast "No Dogs in Space" hasn't released a new episode since July 2024. Season three concluded with a focus on experimental rock, covering bands like Can. Fans eagerly await the next season after abbreviated recent releases.

headline: Zuckerberg's yacht was closer, but someone else saved a stranded boat
summary: A stranded boat near Farragut Bay was rescued by the Wilderness Legacy cruise ship. Tracking data reveals Mark Zuckerberg's super yacht, Launchpad, was actually closer. Zuckerberg's vessel did not participate in the rescue efforts.

headline: 49ers coach says his Tesla was on Autopilot when he crashed
summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan admitted his Tesla's Autopilot was engaged during a recent crash. He previously took full responsibility for the accident in Palo Alto. The revelation adds new details to the incident involving the autonomous driving system.

headline: Dropbox is a PC builder's best friend
summary: Dropbox is highlighted as an essential tool for PC builders, particularly for backup. The author recounts a past fear of losing a large crowdfunded game project due to local storage. Cloud storage services like Dropbox offer crucial peace of mind against data loss.

headline: Blizzard Reportedly Leads Xbox as 'Top-Performing' Studio Thanks to Overwatch and Diablo
summary: Blizzard Entertainment is reportedly Microsoft's top-performing Xbox studio. Success is attributed to key titles like Overwatch and Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred. The studio's strong performance positions it as a 'golden child' within Xbox.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Civilization VII, AirPods Pro 3, Spider-Man: Brand New Day Steelbook, and More
summary: Featured deals include Civilization VII and AirPods Pro 3. The Spider-Man: Brand New Day Steelbook is also available at a discount. The article lists various other sales for today, August 9, 2026.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Swings Closer to $2 Billion in Second Weekend in Theaters, The Odyssey Becomes Highest-Grossing Christopher Nolan Movie of All Time
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day approaches $2 billion globally in its second weekend. "The Odyssey" has become Christopher Nolan's highest-grossing film ever. August box office saw another strong weekend with these two major titles.

headline: Netflix Reportedly Delays The Witcher Season 5 to 2027
summary: Netflix has reportedly pushed back the release of The Witcher Season 5. Geralt's next adventure is now expected to debut in 2027. Fans face a longer wait for the continuation of the popular fantasy series.

headline: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appears in court after extradition
summary: Daniel Kinahan, a suspected crime boss, appeared in court following his extradition. The Irish Prison Service used a specially equipped bulletproof and bombproof van for transport. His court appearance marks a significant development in his case after being brought from Dubai.

headline: How Kinahan's hearing unfolded inside the courtroom in Dublin
summary: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan faced charges in a Dublin courtroom. He was charged with directing the activities of a criminal organization. The charges follow his recent extradition from Dubai.

headline: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
summary: Israel has rejected a 15-point plan for Gaza proposed by Donald Trump. Prime Minister Netanyahu states Israel's military will remain in Gaza. Withdrawal is contingent on Hamas being "genuinely" disarmed, according to Netanyahu.

headline: Ancient Roman shipwreck discovered off Sicily coast
summary: An ancient Roman shipwreck has been discovered off the coast of Sicily. Italy's culture minister hails it as a major underwater archaeological find. The discovery is considered one of the most important in years.
